summary.text: Julian Ivey is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 47A and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He and fellow incumbent Diana Fennell face Republican Fred Price Jr. for the district's two seats.
He is a former Cheverly town councilmember and serves on the Appropriations Committee.

paragraphs.text: Julian Ivey was born in Prince George's County, Maryland, and graduated from Eleanor Roosevelt High School.
He earned a B.A. in political science and government from the University of Maryland, College Park, in 2018.
Ivey served on the Cheverly Town Council from 2017 to 2019 and, according to his legislative biography, has worked since 2023 as an associate account manager at Iron Bow Technologies.
Ivey assumed office on January 9, 2019, according to Ballotpedia.
The General Assembly website lists him as a member of the Appropriations Committee.
